api.retrieval: WithRetrievalHooks(func() RetrievalHooks[M]); Retrieved(context.Context, database.Executor, M); RetrievalObserver[M], NewRetrievalObserver and RegisterRetrievalObserver.
api.scopes: Scope(table.Table, name, func(context.Context) (Predicate[M], error)) returns GlobalScope[M]. WithGlobalScopes(func(T) []GlobalScope[M]) receives an owned value copy of the completed typed declaration and attaches a lazy immutable source.
api.bypasses: WithoutGlobalScope/WithoutGlobalScopes are query-local package functions; WithScopeContext supplies compile-time context only. Apply before taking a lock. WithoutRelationGlobalScope/WithoutRelationGlobalScopes preserve the exact descriptor kind and leave pivot defaults intact. WithoutPivotGlobalScope/WithoutPivotGlobalScopes affect only the pivot.

contracts: Retrieved runs only after complete successful hydration and row closure; local factory before observer factories; factories once per nonempty batch and selected complete role; per-row local callback before observers.

Shared internal/ormcore.Collect owns callback lifetime, close/error/cancellation handling and lifecycle depth for both old/new APIs. Rows.WithObserverScope retains actual resource ownership and callback isolation. Callback errors use the existing lifecore safe wrapper with causes preserved.

Each uses stable bounded closed batches when retrieval may run; known concrete owners may prove absence. Unknown wrappers never receive a capability or prove observer absence. Dispatch uses the actual rows frozen observer set and preserves caller executor identity.
Write hydration, DTOs, scalars and unselected intermediate relation roles skip retrieval. Table.Raw complete models dispatch retrieval while bypassing scopes and routing.

Lazy scopes lower into existing querycore effective predicates, preserving reads, writes, relation targets/pivots, counts/aggregates, joins and subqueries. Inserts are unfiltered. Missing context/tenant, invalid definitions and callback failure fail closed.
Executing context overrides compile-time context even in lowered joins/subqueries. Paginate and SimplePaginate now bind terminal context before preflight compilation.

LazyScopes.Get uses callback.Isolated and waits for source exit before publishing sync.Once state. Panic and Goexit retain safe fault.Panicked errors; invalid source definitions retain fault.Invalid. Every later scoped compilation observes the cached error; source execution is never retried.
